title: resourceCommand
responsibility: Runs an admitted command with inherited streams and bounded lifetime, retaining ownership-aware cleanup failures.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.args
inputs.description: Executable followed by its arguments; the command must be nonempty.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.context
inputs.description: Admitted lease, bounded environment and process-tracking callback passed to the owned command.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal; cancellation preserves cleanup and rejects the operation.

inputs.name: resourceCommand.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Positive command execution limit in milliseconds, bounded by the native timer range.

outputs.name: resourceCommand
outputs.description: Command exit status; failed cleanup or timeout never becomes a successful zero.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid timeout or command, cancellation and owned-runner failures reject or preserve a nonzero result.
